scope: Outcome-blind correspondence review of every H2-retained canonical indicator family against the complete frozen local T0 input inventory.
required_inputs: AI correspondence worksheet exported from the current database
instructions: Review every row; do not sample and do not use a target feature count.
Treat names as leads only. Match only when the measured object, formula or deterministic algorithm, unit, information time, and construct role can be made identical.
Use exact_materialized when a frozen column already represents the same indicator; use exact_derivable when the same indicator can be deterministically calculated from inventoried columns.

Use candidate_formula_completion when local inputs appear sufficient but the current literature fields are too generic to establish exact equivalence; this sends the family to targeted source-formula completion and is not final approval.

Use construct_mismatch for similarly named but mathematically or causally different features, future_only when the required value is post-T0, no_match when inputs are absent, and insufficient_evidence when neither equivalence nor a focused completion route is supportable.
For every positive or formula-completion candidate, list exact source IDs and source_id:column entries from the inventory and explain the proposed derivation and equivalence risk.
Do not inspect target tables, model outcomes, dimensions, final selections, AI/H1/H2 decisions, v2 final feature decisions, Qwen, Ollama, or any model API.
